description: Fetch title, document date, legal type, in-force status hint, and EUR-Lex citation URL for one EU act by CELEX id (e.g. "32016R0679") or alias (e.g. "GDPR"); does not download full text.

celex.description: CELEX id, e.g. "32016R0679", or a known alias like "GDPR".

lang.description: ISO 639-2/B language code for the title (default "eng": eng, fra, deu, spa, ita, …).

name: get_metadata
title: Get Metadata
